summary: Guardian Metal Resources PLC filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 21, 2026, titled Positive Tempiute Tungsten Drilling Results. The registrant reported Phase I and Phase II diamond drilling at its Tempiute tungsten project in Nevada, highlighted by a 92.0m intersection grading 0.34% WO3. Based on results and visual observations from 24 pending holes, the company will begin rehabilitating historical underground workings to enable underground drilling. No M&A, tender, tender offer, activist, strategic review, spin-off, capital return, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change event is disclosed. The filing is a routine operational update; no deal terms apply.
